response.title: how much battery backup do i need for my house
response.answer:

markup:
For a typical U.S. house, I would recommend **20–40 kWh of usable battery storage** if you want meaningful backup during a power outage. But the right size depends on whether you want to power essential appliances or your entire house, including air conditioning.

## How much battery do you need?

| Backup goal | Battery capacity | Typical runtime |
|---|---:|---|
| Essentials only (fridge, Wi-Fi, lights) | 5–10 kWh | 12–24 hours |
| Essentials + some appliances | 10–20 kWh | 12–24 hours |
| Most of the house | 20–40 kWh | Around 1 day |
| Whole house, including AC | 40–80+ kWh | Around 1–2 days |

These are rough estimates. Actual runtime depends heavily on your electricity consumption, especially heating, cooling, and EV charging.

## Example: Tesla Powerwall 3

<row align=start gap={3}>
  <AsyncImage query="Tesla Powerwall 3 installed exterior house wall residential battery" aspectRatio="4:5" maxWidth="155px" shop_eligible={true}/>
  <box flex="1" gap={2}>
    Each <Entity category="product" value="Tesla Powerwall 3" disambig="home battery energy storage system"/> provides approximately **13.5 kWh** of usable storage.

    - 1 Powerwall: 13.5 kWh
    - 2 Powerwalls: 27 kWh
    - 3 Powerwalls: 40.5 kWh
    - 4 Powerwalls: 54 kWh
  </box>
</row>

For many homes, **2–3 Powerwalls** is a reasonable starting point for substantial backup, although large electrical loads may require more power capacity as well as energy storage.

## Let's calculate your actual requirement

{@body const [usage,setUsage] = DIL.useState("30")}
{@body const [goal,setGoal] = DIL.useState("whole")}
{@body const [duration,setDuration] = DIL.useState("24")}
{@body const [solar,setSolar] = DIL.useState("no")}
{@body const daily = Number(usage)||30}
{@body const factor = goal==="essential"?.25:goal==="most"?.65:1}
{@body const needed = daily*factor*Number(duration)/24/.9}
<box border radius="2xl" padding={3} gap={3}>
  <form gap={3} onSubmit={()=>GenUI.issueNewTurn("Size a home battery system for my house. My daily electricity usage is "+usage+" kWh. I want to back up "+(goal==="essential"?"essential circuits":goal==="most"?"most appliances":"my whole house")+" for "+duration+" hours. Solar panels: "+solar+". Include recommended usable kWh, approximate battery count, and power-output considerations.")}>
    <box gap={1}>
      <label>Average daily electricity usage</label>
      <radio-group direction="col" value={usage} onChange={setUsage}>
        <radio value="15">15 kWh/day — low usage</radio>
        <radio value="30">30 kWh/day — average usage</radio>
        <radio value="50">50 kWh/day — high usage</radio>
        <radio value="80">80 kWh/day — very high usage</radio>
      </radio-group>
      <caption>You can find this on your electricity bill or utility account.</caption>
    </box>
    <divider color="subtle"/>
    <box gap={1}>
      <label>What do you want to power?</label>
      <radio-group direction="col" value={goal} onChange={setGoal}>
        <radio value="essential">Essential circuits only</radio>
        <radio value="most">Most household appliances</radio>
        <radio value="whole">Entire house, including AC</radio>
      </radio-group>
    </box>
    <box gap={1}>
      <label>Desired backup duration</label>
      <radio-group direction="col" value={duration} onChange={setDuration}>
        <radio value="12">12 hours</radio>
        <radio value="24">24 hours</radio>
        <radio value="48">48 hours</radio>
        <radio value="72">72 hours</radio>
      </radio-group>
    </box>
    <box gap={1}>
      <label>Do you have solar panels?</label>
      <radio-group direction="row" value={solar} onChange={setSolar}>
        <radio value="yes">Yes</radio>
        <radio value="no">No</radio>
        <radio value="planning">Planning to</radio>
      </radio-group>
    </box>
    <box background="surface-secondary" radius="xl" padding={3} gap={1}>
      <text color="secondary" weight="medium" size="xs">Estimated usable battery capacity</text>
      <title size="2xl" color="default" tabularNums>{Math.ceil(needed)} kWh</title>
      <text color="secondary" size="sm">Approximately {Math.ceil(needed/13.5)} Tesla Powerwall 3 units</text>
      <caption>Preliminary estimate using typical load fractions and a 10% reserve/loss allowance. Solar recharge is not included.</caption>
    </box>
    <button block submit>Calculate my battery recommendation <icon name="arrow-right" inline/></button>
  </form>
</box>

One important distinction: **kWh determines how long your battery lasts, while kW determines how many appliances it can power simultaneously.** For whole-house backup, we need to check both, particularly if you have central AC, electric heating, or an EV charger.
